method: Import exact stored float32 STL coordinates promoted to float64 via Mesh64, with only exact-position vertex indexing, require Manifold NoError; slice at each original failed reference Z without changing it; to_polygons contours combined by even-odd symmetric difference in Shapely without repair. Independent of original 0.0001 mm endpoint clustering.
limitations: Manifold and Shapely use floating-point geometry. This is an independent numerical supplement, not an exact-arithmetic proof.
Original failed contour, degree-1 vertices and 18 null records remain untouched. Supplemental distances are separate evidence at exactly the same original Z.
Distances to horizontal solid are geometric backing measurements, not support generation, tool clearance or proof of printability.
